name: data.export
title: Export data
summary: Data of the current state as JSON for external evaluation, or, from the command line and the API, as JSON Lines with one element per line; a selection narrows it.
details: Every element unless a selection is given, so an evaluation selects by filter, package, baseline or variant instead of exporting everything; no paging. A baseline selects the elements it lists, as they are now. `data store` writes a whole state to a file.
